source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Whenever a model of yours uses a [Bondsman](vsdata:ability/imperial-knights.bondsman) ability, and no other model of yours has used that same ability in the turn, you can pick up to 3 **ARMIGER** models of yours for it, not just one. Each has to be up to 12" from the model, or up to 15" if your army has become [Honoured](vsdata:ability/imperial-knights.code-chivalric), and none can be a model that a Bondsman ability already affects. The ability then affects those models until [your next Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase).
